mapper.select:
SELECT task_no
FROM obt_task
WHERE task_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
ORDER BY task_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE obt_task
status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_msg = #{errorMsg},
started_at = IFNULL(started_at, NOW()),
finished_at = NOW(),
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT *
FROM obt_task
ORDER BY
id status initial_capital final_equity annual_return_pct max_drawdown_pct sharpe_ratio win_rate_pct total_trades gmt_create total_return_pct
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
